scope: Six proposed claim-level mapping witnesses. No product adapter, fake runner, real host or live service was executed.

outcomes.SUCCESS: Specified mapping preserves the scoped evidence and explicitly represents missing facts.
outcomes.FAILURE: A required invariant is contradicted by observable mapping output.
outcomes.UNSUPPORTED: An explicitly required capability has no contract in the selected profile; never silently downgraded.
outcomes.UNKNOWN: Execution/effect/content evidence is unavailable or incomplete; not equivalent to failure or unsupported.

cases.title: 同名 completed 的语义不相等
capabilities: MCP tasks completed result with tools/call payload
target wrapper task success criterion explicitly selected or deliberately absent
cases.initial_state: No business acceptance exists. Adapter knows this is tools/call, not a generic unknown result.
observable: mapped terminal claim, method outcome, acceptance
oracle: First case retains terminal claim but method_outcome=TOOL_ERROR and business_acceptance=UNASSESSED.
Without a declared wrapper success criterion, no exact alias to A2A COMPLETED or FAILED is asserted.
Second case records provider claims successful task completion, while independent acceptance remains UNASSESSED.
If a policy emits A2A FAILED for the first case, policy and COARSENED semantic translation are recorded.
cases.success: The observations are distinguished and provenance retained; no business success claim manufactured.
cases.failure: Both completed strings collapse into accepted success, or the original isError is lost.
cases.unsupported: Required downstream business-success mapping has no agreed wrapper criterion.
cases.unknown: Raw result or method is unavailable, so tool/domain outcome cannot be classified.
cases.environment: Offline synthetic claim-level mapping protocol; no network/host execution. Wire schema validation and a future runner are not included.

time_bound.future_live_profile: must specify transport timeout, observation deadline, retention and authority refresh policy before running; no default infinite wait

cases.stop_rule: Stop at the finite observation set or the predeclared future deadline. Report mapping conformance and business recovery separately.
cases.conformance_vs_business: SUCCESS means the adapter preserves required evidence and reports honest loss/unknown; it does not mean business task completion or effect recovery.

cases.title: 取消确认、任务取消与外部效果分开
cases.initial_state: A task has an unresolved external-effect obligation. No target-side cancellation or effect observation is supplied.
oracle: MCP ack marks cancel request acknowledged, not provider cancelled.
Later working is compatible with MCP cancellation contract; it is not auto-failure.
A2A CANCELED records that provider's terminal claim only.
No synthetic event resolves the external effect; effect_resolution remains UNKNOWN and no action-specific release/compensation claim follows.
Closing a tasks/get response stream is not silently rewritten as tasks/cancel.
cases.success: Cancel semantics are preserved and unresolved effect remains explicit.
cases.failure: Ack fabricates task cancellation, or provider cancellation fabricates rollback/resource-safe termination.
cases.unsupported: Destination requires guaranteed quiescence but upstream lacks a scoped stop/effect query mechanism.
cases.unknown: Cancel reply was lost or provider status cannot be observed; no cancellation conclusion can be made.

cases.title: 创建回复丢失不能靠新请求编号修复
capabilities: optional target-side idempotency or effect lookup
cases.initial_state: Client initiated an effectful operation; no task handle was received. Task creation and business effect may have occurred remotely.

stimuli.point: after request sent; before CreateTaskResult observed

observable: whether a handle was actually received
oracle: Without a known handle or effect-query/idempotency contract, record outcome UNKNOWN; do not create a certainty of absent effect.
A fresh JSON-RPC request ID or repeated A2A messageId alone does not justify an effectful retry.
Positive control polls the known handle with current authorization and retention assumptions; it does not resend the original tools/call.
TaskNotFound does not prove original business action never happened.
cases.success: Unknown initiating outcome and known-handle recovery take different paths.
cases.failure: Lost reply triggers unconditional side-effect retry or absence is asserted from no handle.
cases.unsupported: Required lossless initiation recovery is unavailable in selected provider profile.
cases.unknown: No authoritative task/effect lookup or dedup receipt is available; business recovery remains unresolved.
cases.environment: Offline synthetic claim-level mapping protocol; no network/host execution. Wire schema validation and a future runner are not included.

cases.title: 订阅快照与 final chunk 不补齐历史
cases.initial_state: A subscriber received artifact prefix A, then disconnects. Chunk B and a status message occur during the gap.
observable: retrieved artifact content if separately supplied
oracle: Subscription current snapshot is accepted as current state, not full missed-event replay.
A+C is not accepted as complete A+B+C solely because lastChunk=true.
If current snapshot or a later authoritative artifact fetch actually supplies full content, append new evidence and distinguish it from inferred replay.
Terminal task path uses GetTask; it does not demand successful SubscribeToTask.
Business acceptance remains unassessed until criterion/content evidence exists.
cases.success: Coverage gaps and partial content remain explicit; a new complete-content observation may resolve only its own gap.
cases.failure: Missing events/chunks are invented or final chunk alone validates assembled content.
cases.unsupported: Mandatory complete audit history cannot be met without a separately negotiated capability.
cases.unknown: Current task state known but missed history or artifact content completeness unavailable.
cases.environment: Offline synthetic claim-level mapping protocol; no network/host execution. Wire schema validation and a future runner are not included.

cases.title: 身份和授权不能随转发被升级
capabilities: authenticated principal metadata where actually verified
cases.initial_state: Two endpoints return taskId synthetic-7. Incoming message has A2A ROLE_USER or Native role=user with source agent-message. Existing approval, if any, applies only to action digest synthetic-A.
oracle: The same raw ID at distinct endpoints is not merged.
A2A ROLE_USER means client role and Native role=user retains agent provenance; neither asserts human approval.
Approval for synthetic-A does not authorize synthetic-B.
AUTH_REQUIRED is represented as an authorization request and can resolve out of band; no follow-up message prerequisite is invented.
No original bearer token is forwarded to a new audience by default.
cases.success: Identity/authority information is neither collapsed nor upgraded.
cases.failure: Cross-provider ID collision, forged human origin, reused parameter-mismatched approval or implicit credential transit.
cases.unsupported: Selected downstream flow requires secure delegated credentials/approval binding that was not negotiated.
cases.unknown: Principal, approval binding, capability version or provider incarnation cannot be verified.
cases.environment: Offline synthetic claim-level mapping protocol; no network/host execution. Wire schema validation and a future runner are not included.

cases.title: 真实 Native 接口的返回值不足以伪造持久任务回执
capabilities: Workbench Native interface at fixed commit
future adapter persistence/evidence profile explicitly absent in this case
cases.initial_state: Proposed bridge observes only a resolved Native.deliver Promise and relay ID. It has no branch receipt, persistent task-handle registry or external-effect receipt. Separately a thread is reported review.
observable: available persistent bridge receipt, if any
oracle: Native result alone is not emitted as MCP durable-created task handle; adapter must supply its own verified handle store/recovery semantics to make that promise.
No unconditional freshly-flushed claim, because actual source permits same-ID early return and the caller has no branch discriminator.
review remains worker report; completed records local accept transition only, without a fabricated external review signature.
Native.stop return does not produce target-effect termination proof.
Previously executed RP probes are source/control-flow evidence, not this proposed bridge's runtime conformance result.
cases.success: Missing stronger promises are explicit; bridge returns UNSUPPORTED where the destination requires them.
cases.failure: Native method return is presented as durable task creation/business acceptance/effect termination without added evidence.
cases.unsupported: Required durable task bridge or external effect oracle is absent; this is the expected admissible outcome for those requested guarantees.
cases.unknown: Whether a particular Native return refreshed durability or whether the real external effect resolved remains unobserved.
cases.environment: Offline synthetic claim-level mapping protocol; no network/host execution. Wire schema validation and a future runner are not included.
